description: Book an appointment on a job: a dated visit with a time window and the technicians assigned to it. This is how a job gets scheduled. The job's own schedule follows the visit, so one call books the work and dispatches it, and calling it again on the same job adds a second visit. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Booking an appointment does not itself email or text the customer. Housecall Pro still sends its own reminders as the date approaches, and that depends on your account's settings. To move a visit or change who is on it use hcp_update_job_appointment; to undo a booking use hcp_delete_job_appointment or hcp_unschedule_job. Every appointment needs at least one technician - Housecall Pro rejects one with nobody assigned.

arrival_window_minutes.description: How wide an arrival window to give the customer, in minutes. Housecall Pro accepts 0, 15, 20, 60, 120, 180 or 240 and rejects anything else. Default 0.

employee_ids.description: Technicians to dispatch (pro_... ids from hcp_list_employees). At least one is required.

name: hcp_schedule_job_appointment
